Synopsis:
Foreign investors returned to net buying of Asian equities in August after a nine-month selling streak, driven by AI-linked tech stock demand and a strong earnings season. Taiwan led inflows ($11.15B), while South Korea saw continued outflows ($8.65B). India attracted $3.1B for a second consecutive month of net purchases. Analysts note the recovery is AI-allocation driven rather than broad-based, with bond yields, oil prices and geopolitical risks flagged as ongoing volatility factors.
